items.title: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Flaw Linked to $70 Million Bitcoin Theft in 41 Minutes
items.description: An attacker drained 1,196 Bitcoin addresses in 41 minutes on July 30, taking 1,082.65 BTC worth about $70.2 million at the time. Galaxy Research mapped the sweep and tied it to a firmware flaw in Coldcard, the Bitcoin-only hardware wallet made by Canadian firm Coinkite.
